title: NeverLoseAPromoAgain
tagline: AI Agent that buys the best deals even while you sleep, 24/7
description: We are building and AI shopping agent which browses the web 24/7 to find the product which you desires, on spot. Whenever finds your product, it buys it for you. Whenever it is within the range, he could be automatically integrated to borrow funds from defi protocols. He must have World ID validation of a Human using, as well as provide banking credit informnation. It also have their own address provided by ENS which ensure their unique authencity. Whenever has it funds conduct the payout and buys the product, solving the pucharse problem with sales and promos.
how_its_made:
We've integrated open claw, to a webserver, where we've later integrated multiple providers, for pricing, llm, messaging, and partners such as World, Arc and ENS. We use the partners for user validation, for loans and purchase on chain ensuring the identity and not spamming from future users to the tool, as well as arc nanopayments feature to allow James to payout 24/7, ensuring the opportunities to be taken, even while sleep. We used telegram interface to ensure everybody can use it easily and help people worldwide. We've used to deploy as well the infrastcure within Railway solution and its partners for database.
